say: Food. You got food? Give!
Hungry. So hungry. Look at me.
Stay there. Don't move. Don't make me hungrier.
Waaah! Food! Where's food?
Smell that? That's you. That's dinner.
Not hunting you. Not yet. Don't test me.
No blade? Hah! Easy! Easy meat!
Nothing in your hands. Good. Good for us.
Unarmed. Stupid or rich. Both are food.
No weapon! No fight! Just give!
You walk with nothing. We'll fix that. We'll take what you have.
Nothing in your pockets. Same as us.
Broke. Starving. Like us. Hah! Go, go.
Empty purse? Then you're no use.
You have nothing? We have nothing.
FOOOOD! I'm taking your food!
Waaah! Get them! Get the food!
Hungry! So hungry! ARRRGH!
Gimme! Gimme! Gimme!
I've been hit harder than that.
Kill it! Eat it! Kill it!
Ahh... food. Finally. Some food.
Dead? Good. More for us.
Eat now. Fight later.
Search them! Search them for food!
Hahh! Not so tough now, are you?
Hey. Hey! You dead? Got food?
Down. Good. Check the pockets.
Poor thing. Poor, poor thing. Hungry too?
Meat on the ground. Meat!
Mine! All mine!
Food? Food? FOOD?
Take everything. Everything!
Nothing. Nothing. NOTHING. Nobody has anything.
Look at you. Full pockets. Full belly.
You have money. You have food. Why you have everything?
Cats! Cats can buy food! Give cats!
Hah! Rich one! Rich one walks the road!
